functions.name: Aashirbaad
functions.notes: Held separately at both homes; elders of the other family visit.

functions.name: Gaye Holud
functions.notes: Starts before sunrise with Dodhi Mangal; turmeric goes from the groom's home to the bride's.

functions.name: Biye (wedding ceremony)
functions.notes: Exact lagna timing from the family purohit.

highLevelTasks.title: Confirm the lagna and ritual timings with the family purohit
Book the wedding venue and the Bou Bhaat venue
Shortlist caterers and do a tasting for the wedding dinner and Bou Bhaat
Book photographer and videographer for all four days
Finalise décor theme for the chhadnatola and reception stage
Buy the bride's Benarasi and the groom's dhoti-panjabi and topor
Design, print and distribute invitation cards
Arrange tattva trays and gifts exchanged between the families
Book shehnai or music for the wedding evening
Arrange cars for the bor jatri and Bidaai
Collect puja and ritual items for each ceremony
Plan the Bou Bhaat guest list and seating

rationale: The rituals fall naturally into six functions over four days, from Aashirbaad two days before the wedding to Bou Bhaat two days after. Catering takes the largest share because the wedding dinner and Bou Bhaat each feed the full guest list; smaller rituals are kept to close family.
